Describe the problem and the change.

## Verification

- [ ] `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test tool`
- [ ] `flutter analyze`
- [ ] `flutter test`

## Release and privacy

- [ ] Documentation or changelog updated when behavior changed
- [ ] No credentials, local paths, signing files, or private media added
- [ ] New dependencies and media assets have compatible licenses
